page.overview:
Who is Esmer Balenta?

is an explosives manufacturer, operating a black powder business from Finders Takers in Bassuras. As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer.

Esmer is a tall, slender, gorgeous woman with jet-black skin and white, almost bleached hair that's parted in the center that goes just past the chin. When Bells Hells first met her, she was clad in a dirty white work shirt and a dark purple-red thick leather vest that cut off mid-torso. She also wore a thick pair of goggles with multiple relatively intricate lenses.

Esmer owns and operates the Finders Takers shop in the East Dregs of Bassuras, and manufactures black powder, firearms, and dynamite. Dancer had frequently sent F.C.G. to Esmer's shop. Esmer had also been dating Dancer, and had last seen her in mid-Brussendar, 843 PD, about a month before meeting Bells Hells.

Accompanied by Dusk and Fearne, who sought supplies to infiltrate the Seat of Disdain, Fresh Cut Grass went to see Esmer to tell her the news of Dancer's death. Esmer was surprised to see FCG and asked if Dancer sent them. FCG tried to gently tell her Dancer was brutally murdered a few months ago, but Esmer spat out her wine and told them they were lying, that was impossible. Dancer came alone to the shop a month ago trying to reconnect with Esmer, and Esmer bought her sad stories and let her stay for a few days. But when things got "a little too intimate", Dancer vanished again. Esmer thought she was probably at The Ends.
